title: Flow Edge Port Trim
description: Flow edges should not render behind port handles; they should start after the port cap. Bezier start/end tangent vectors should be gentler.
summary: Flow/DAG edges now start and end at the exterior peak of port handle caps (rim + outward × radius) instead of the node rim, so wire strokes no longer show behind semicircle ports. Bezier control tangent length reduced from 35% to 22% of chord (clamp 16–120 world units) for gentler curves. Added handle_exterior_cap_peak helper and unit test; updated wire snap preview test.
